components.name: google_places_search

inputs.keyword: Query to search for in Google Places, according to the user's request.
inputs.location: Location to search for the query, specific enough and matching user's request if specified. If not specified, default to Buenos Aires, Argentina.

outputs.search_response: List of places found by Google Places. Each element is an object with the following fields: 'name', 'formatted_address', 'rating' (average rating), 'user_ratings_total' (number of user ratings), 'price_level', 'opening_hours', 'open_now', 'phone_number', 'website', 'editorial_summary' (a general summary of the place) and 'reviews'. Some of these fields might not be available.

default_output.search_response: Error: Google Places could not be searched.

components.description: Find places using Google Places. Requires 'PLACES_API_KEY'.

components.name: youtube_search

inputs.query: Query to be searched on YouTube, based on the context of the conversation.
inputs.n_results: Number of videos to search for, the default is 3 unless otherwise specified.

outputs.video_list: List of videos found. Each element in the list is a JSON with the fields 'title', 'description', 'url' and 'transcript' (null when the video has no transcript or it could not be retrieved).

default_output.video_list: Error: YouTube could not be searched.

components.description: Find YouTube videos and their transcripts. Requires 'YOUTUBE_API_KEY', and installing 'google-api-python-client' and 'youtube-transcript-api'.

components.name: current_date
components.description: Get the current date and time in the system's timezone (general_parameters.timezone, UTC by default). Returns current_date.

components.name: calendar_search

inputs.start_date: First day of the search in YYYY-MM-DD format.
inputs.end_date: Last day of the search in YYYY-MM-DD format (included). Use the same date as start_date to search a single day.
inputs.calendar_id: ID of the specific calendar that will be searched.

outputs.event_list: List of events found within the searched days.

default_output.event_list: Error: the calendar could not be searched.

components.description: Find events in a specific calendar between two dates (both included, as days in the system's timezone). Requires 'CALENDAR_API_KEY' and installing 'google-api-python-client'.

components.name: create_mercadopago_payment_url

inputs.name: The name that will appear in the payment link.
inputs.price: The total price to pay, in the specified currency.
inputs.currency: The currency to use ('ARS' or 'USD'). If nothing was specified default to USD.
inputs.quantity: The quantity of the service (default to 1, unless something else seems more appropriate).

outputs.payment_url: The URL where the user can complete the payment.

default_output.payment_url: There was an error creating the URL.

components.description: Create Mercadopago payment links. Requires 'MERCADOPAGO_ACCESS_TOKEN' and installing 'mercadopago'.

components.name: markdown_to_pdf
components.description: Turn markdown into a PDF file. Requires 'markdown' and the 'wkhtmltopdf' program (on PATH, or set 'WKHTMLTOPDF_PATH'). The latest message must include a text block with JSON containing 'markdown' and 'title'. Raw HTML in the markdown is shown as text. The PDF is saved in the files folder; returns a text block with pdf_file_path and a document block that bots send as a file.

components.name: weather_search

inputs.location: The name of the location to query weather for.
inputs.unit: The unit system for temperature ('metric' or 'imperial').

outputs.temperature: Current temperature in the specified unit.

default_output.condition: Error: the weather could not be retrieved.

components.description: Get weather data for a specified location. Requires 'WEATHER_API_KEY' for 'https://api.weatherapi.com'.

components.name: get_google_doc
components.description: Retrieve full text from a specified Google Document. Requires 'GOOGLE_DRIVE_API' and the 'GOOGLE_DOC_ID'. Returns doc_text.
